[[Category:Mathematical optimisation]]
'''Mathematical optimisation''' is the process of finding the maximum(a) and/or minimum(a) of a [[function]].

== Mathematical equivalence of maximum-minimum ==

$$
f_{min}=f(X) \iff f_{max}=-f(X); \\
f_{max}=f(X) \iff f_{min}=-f(X).
$$
